pluginConfigFields.label: Analyzer addresses
pluginConfigFields.help: IP addresses or hostnames of N9340B units on the show network, separated by commas. Each one is probed while SoundBase is looking for devices. You can also add a unit by address from the device picker instead. On Windows, units connected by USB are found without an address, on either Keysight's driver (IO Libraries Suite) or Microsoft's WinUSB driver (see the README); USB is not available on macOS.

deviceConfigFields.label: IP address
deviceConfigFields.help: The analyzer's address on the network. Find it on the analyzer under SYS > Setting > I/O Config > LAN.

deviceConfigFields.label: VXI-11 port
deviceConfigFields.help: Leave empty. The analyzer tells us its port through the standard RPC port mapper; set this only if that is blocked by a firewall.
